english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for tasteful, elegant clothing, style, or presentation.
Choose this when the emphasis is on having good taste rather than merely following trends.
Use this for art, objects, or people that show cultured, refined taste rather than worldly experience or technical complexity.

examples.english: This suit has a simple cut and looks classy.
examples.traditional: 呢套西裝剪裁簡潔，睇落好有品味。
